Terribly unpleasant service, the male server, maybe the owner, I told him which vitamin I was looking for, he couldn't find anything else recommended, I didn't ask for it, because I had a targeted search. Then I told him some low-fat kibble, because he has a dog with pancreatitis. He brings me something over 5%, I say it should be below that, unfortunately, a higher one will cause problems right away... . He points to another product, only from afar so that I can bring that vegetable, here it's already phlegmatic. I didn't want to buy it, so I say thank you very much, hello. I said goodbye, loudly. He doesn't say hello to me, when I turn back I say hello, he hardly says hello. It's not enough that he wants to push a product on you that isn't good, he doesn't even say hello several times, even though I was normal and respectful the whole time. I don't recommend it because of that.
